output.reason: PMK 66/2023 makes benefits in kind (natura/kenikmatan) received by employees taxable income subject to PPh withholding. It also sets exemptions with value thresholds, such as meal coupons up to Rp2,000,000 per month, and lays down valuation rules (market value or cost) and the timing of withholding. It suspends withholding for January–June 2023, so employer withholding (PPh 21) on natura starts from July 2023. This changes the gross income and the PPh 21 computation for permanent employees.
